title: A kitchen gets a fresh start

scenes.narration: This dated kitchen is ready for a bright, welcoming start.
First, we clear the clutter and carefully prepare every surface.
Fresh cabinet finishes add warmth while keeping the familiar layout.
New countertops and a clean backsplash give a crisp finish.
Soft lighting highlights the details and makes everyday cooking inviting.
Now this refreshed kitchen becomes the welcoming heart of home.
